step_sizing.method: For raw neural delta J_network(q) times requested translation, use factor min(1, nextafter(0.02,0)/max(abs(delta))). Apply that same scalar to delta and requested translation. This preserves direction, limits joint movement and is computed from the neural output only. Zero requested translation produces exactly zero delta. A forward-only robot guard may refuse; no inverse solver or geometric repair is permitted. Report every factor to disclose reduced step size and future speed implications.

scope: Measured joints and requested local XY translation only; neural delta, explicit joint limiting, forward-only refusal guard.
